text:
arjun: Quick community announcement — launching a small grants program + weekend Plugin Sprint. We pushed a minimal plugin template repo and we're taking grant apps (up to $5k) to help community maintainers build adapters/plugins that integrate Redwood with external runtimes and tooling. Links + quick start below. RSVP if you want to ship a plugin during the sprint (Sat/Sun).

release-bot: Release published: redwood-inference/plugin-template v0.1.0
https://github.com/redwood-inference/plugin-template/releases/tag/v0.1.0
Changelog: add plugin scaffolding, example adapter, CI + test matrix, CONTRIBUTING.md, grant submission checklist.

arjun: Quick start (scaffold a plugin):
```bash
npx @redwood-inference/create-plugin my-runtime-adapter
cd my-runtime-adapter
npm install
npm run test
```

bea: License? want to make sure grant recipients can relicense work if needed.

arjun: We're using Apache-2.0 for the template so downstream projects have broad compatibility. Grant terms will be in the application form.

leo: What's the eligibility window and selection criteria?

arjun: Grants open for 2 weeks. Criteria: technical fit, maintenance plan, tests, and a short rollout plan. Preference for reusable adapters (runtime, infra, quant backends). Full details in GRANTS.md in the repo.

maya: I can run a 30-min onboarding workshop Fri 2pm PT to walk through the template and tests. Volunteers to co-host?

sam: I'll co-host and cover CI secrets + security checklist.

arjun: Awesome, thanks @maya and @sam. DevRel will record it.

devrel-bot: Plugin Sprint RSVP + grant app form: https://forms.gle/example-plugin-sprint (put repo link, short description, and if you want mentorship)

bea: Security note: templates should avoid embedding any cloud creds. We added SECURITY.md and a CI check that fails if common secret patterns are committed. Maintainers, please review before merging community PRs.

arjun: Good catch. We included .env.example and a CI policy in the template; also added a maintainer checklist for security review.

release-bot: Patch notes snippet:
- feat: scaffold plugin-template with example runtime adapter
- ci: GH Actions test matrix + secret-scan check
- docs: GRANTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, MAINTAINERS.md

leo: Newsletter blurb for community digest? two lines please.

arjun: "plugin-template v0.1 + Community Grants  seed funding (up to $5k) and a weekend Plugin Sprint to build reusable adapters and integrations. Sign up for onboarding + sprint."

maya: Adding the workshop and sprint to the community calendar now. :rocket:

arjun: Thanks all. If you're thinking of applying for a grant, open a draft issue in the repo and link to the form so we can triage early. See you at the sprint! :fire:
